images.prompt: A graph showing the function $f(x) = e^x$ (dark blue curve) and its Taylor polynomial approximations around $x=0$. Show $P_0(x)=1$ (horizontal line), $P_1(x)=1+x$ (straight line tangent), and $P_2(x)=1+x+x^2/2$ (parabola). The approximations should be shown in different colors, clearly demonstrating how they get closer to $e^x$ as more terms are added, especially near $x=0$. Axes should be labeled x and y.
